title: 连接 Atlas Cloud 账户
description: 填入你自己的 Atlas Cloud API Key。生成费用记在这个账户上，凭证只保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不经过云端。
description_en: Enter your own Atlas Cloud API key. Generation is billed to this account, and the credential is stored only on this machine.

fields.label: Atlas Cloud API Key
fields.description: 登录 console.atlascloud.ai → API Keys 创建。
fields.description_en: Create one at console.atlascloud.ai → API Keys.
